CTS now supported on NVIDIA Isaac Sim
Broader developer access can accelerate adoption in robotics and Physical AI.
Ties Synaptics’ edge AI into NVIDIA’s healthcare/edge stack, easing deployment.
Positions SYNA in humanoid/robotics growth segments with tactile demand.
Enables synthetic tactile data in sim
Faster validation cycles can shorten time-to-market for OEMs.
Combines touch, vision, motor signals; increases SYNA’s system value.

This is an early-stage strategy move aligning Synaptics’ edge AI and tactile sensing with NVIDIA’s robotics ecosystem. For a larger catalyst, watch for OEM design wins, revenue contributions, or quantified adoption metrics from robotics platforms.
